description: Why: the test ipfs_and_msgid_persist_when_log_fails explicitly asserts that msgid_map entries survive a log-append failure, documenting a partial-commit characteristic. This is a known correctness issue (article in IPFS + msgid_map but not in group log) that will cause the article to be invisible to readers but prevent it from being reingested. No issue tracks fixing this. What: the test documents the behaviour as expected rather than as a known deficiency. File a separate issue to add two-phase commit or compensating rollback between IPFS write and log append.
title: fault_sqlite_failure test documents partial-commit without asserting it is fixed
